name: ruflo-federation
description: Cross-installation agent federation with zero-trust security, peer discovery, consensus-based task routing, and per-call budget circuit breaker (ADR-097)

guard.title: Secret guard
guard.description: Refuse outbound federation messages that hold a key, token or password (and, while the PII guard is on, an SSN or card number). On by default; it only ever tightens.

piiGuard.title: PII guard
piiGuard.description: While the secret guard is on, also refuse outbound federation messages that hold personal data (an SSN or a card number). Off lets personal data leave; secrets are still refused. On by default.
